logline: A four-part documentary follows Burning Man through pandemic shutdowns, a renegade gathering, destructive rain and a fight over whether growth has compromised its counterculture ideals.

renewal.note: HBO announced the project as a four-part documentary series with weekly episodes through July 30, 2026.

seasons.review_body: The Man Will Burn uses long-term access to Burning Man leadership, volunteers, artists and archival footage to examine how a temporary desert city became a global institution. The four weekly chapters move from the event's counterculture roots through pandemic cancellations, an unofficial renegade gathering, the influence of technology money and the rain-soaked 2023 edition. Only the opening episode had landed when this entry was refreshed, so BollyAI is keeping both score and verdict open. The page exists to give the new release a reliable home while the full documentary argument is still unfolding.
